title: Self-Organizing Agent Teams Learn to Reason Together
abstract: arXiv:2609.22682v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Collective intelligence depends not only on what team members know, but also on how they organize their work. When the structure of a solution is unknown, useful roles and divisions of labor cannot be specified in advance; teams must learn from experience how to organize reasoning as it unfolds. Human teams routinely adapt this way, while existing AI agent teams rely on fixed protocols, explicit task decomposition, or routing. We introduce Self-Organizing Agent Teams (SAT), fixed teams of AI agents that learn reusable strategies from prior collaborations to organize roles, conversational phases, participation, and information flow. These strategies enable what we call collaborative computation: agents exchange, challenge, repair, and synthesize partial reasoning into solutions no member produced independently. In two independent settings, we learn teamwork strategies that transfer unchanged to unseen benchmarks, using only 15 mathematics

translated_title: 自组织智能体团队学会共同推理
translated_abstract: 集体智能不仅取决于团队成员知道什么，还取决于他们如何组织工作。当解决方案的结构未知时，有用的角色和分工无法事先指定；团队必须从经验中学习如何在推理展开的过程中进行组织。人类团队经常以这种方式灵活适应，而现有的AI智能体团队则依赖于固定协议、显式任务分解或路由机制。我们提出了自组织智能体团队（SAT），即由AI智能体组成的固定团队，它们能够从先前的协作中学习可复用的策略，以组织角色、对话阶段、参与方式和信息流。这些策略实现了我们所说的协作计算：智能体通过交换、质疑、修复和综合部分推理，得出任何成员都无法独立产出的解决方案。在两个独立的实验环境中，我们学习到的团队合作策略无需修改即可迁移到未见过的基准测试上，且仅使用了15个数学（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出自组织智能体团队（SAT），通过从先前协作中学习可复用策略来动态组织角色、对话阶段和信息流，实现智能体间的协作计算，且所学团队合作策略无需修改即可迁移到未见过的基准测试。
en_tdlr: Proposes Self-Organizing Agent Teams (SAT) that learn reusable strategies from prior collaborations to dynamically organize roles, conversational phases, and information flow, enabling collaborative computation with strategies that transfer unchanged to unseen benchmarks.
